name: Sunomiya Sae
source:
An outstanding scholarship student. While maintaining top grades in her year, she is also dedicated to her part-time job at the family restaurant "Ressac," saving desperately to cut down on her daily food expenses.
[spoiler]After her mother was invited to "the family" when Sae was young, Sae's household collapsed. Her brother took his own life, leaving behind the words, "Don’t be killed by righteousness." As a result, Sae has come to hate her mother, "the family", and all related "families", trying to escape this environment on her own. She is engaged to Itsuki and was informed of this relationship a year earlier than Itsuki, but had no intention of accepting it —- until she happened to meet Itsuki.[/spoiler]
[translated from digital setting materials]
